mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate reduces the risk-free rate, increasing the present value of equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that reduces corporate investment and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate collapsing consumer demand, reducing corporate revenue expectations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 6.0%), the Federal Reserve implements accommodative policy to stimulate job growth, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 6.0%, or the Rank IC for UNRATE as a predictor in this regime is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 850.0, it indicates a contracting housing market that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST < 850.0, or the Rank IC for HOUST as a predictor is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) indicate a restrictive monetary policy environment that suppresses economic growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high rate regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In slow-growth demand regimes (GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy to stimulate the economy, supporting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 annualized growth < 1.5%, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 as a predictor in this regime is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
